label: PHP Value to JS
description: Serializes a PHP expression into the page and exposes it as a JavaScript variable.

properties.name: php_expression
properties.label: PHP expression
properties.help: Do not add PHP tags or a trailing semicolon. Examples: $user ?? null, get_value('user'), $rows.

properties.name: js_variable_name
properties.label: JavaScript variable name
properties.help: A const with this name is created at the top of the owning JavaScript Flow.
